svg.text: B / blue → gold: dark → bright. N / more dots: tonal → noise-like. Values 0–100; transitions are linear.
Left slope: entrance time. Right slope: release time. Empty space: silence. Height is fixed, not loudness.
The stored score also carries pitch, gain, and decay. This visual projection alone does not encode every synthesis parameter.
